radius_basis: Preregistered geometric candidate, not a measured minimum turning radius or q guard
selection: Try frozen P1 first; then other unique frozen buffer candidates in increasing original cost; accept first completely certified fillet
rejection: UNSMOOTHABLE with evidence UNKNOWN; never shrink radius, change PID, speed, lookahead, safety or timeout
comparison: P2 may change candidate polyline as well as fillet; report provenance, do not claim isolated curvature causal effect
los_scope: lookahead < 0.8 of each sampled arc; does not certify off-path guidance chord or physical execution
